isolation.argv: codex exec --strict-config --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral --model MODEL <-c config ...> <--disable feature ...> --json --color never --cd /workspace --output-last-message /output/final.txt -
isolation.auth: ChatGPT login file mounted from a descriptor into the sandbox tmpfs; never read into a receipt, never hashed, never copied
isolation.environment: HOME=/isolated/home CODEX_HOME=/run/codex-home PATH=/runtime/vendor/codex-path:/usr/bin:/bin LANG=LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 NO_COLOR=1; the launching session's environment is not inherited (the outer process runs the CLI with PATH, LANG and LC_ALL only)
isolation.model: single-entry projected bundled catalog (tool_mode direct, shell disabled, apply_patch off, node repl off); approval never; permissions text_only (filesystem deny all, network off); web search, plan, user-input, agents and apps off; no project docs, no environment context, no skills; 32 features disabled (--disable), among them shell_tool, unified_exec, code_mode, browser_use, computer_use, multi_agent, memories, plugins, hooks, unbounded_connection_retries
isolation.sandbox: bubblewrap --die-with-parent --new-session --unshare-pid --unshare-ipc --unshare-uts; /usr read-only, /proc, /dev, tmpfs /tmp; vendored CLI read-only at /runtime/vendor, inputs read-only at /input, outputs at /output, empty /workspace and /isolated/home, tmpfs CODEX_HOME
isolation.verification: before every call: `codex --version`, `codex debug models --bundled` (catalog projection) and a model-free prompt inspection (`debug prompt-input`, or the rejecting loopback capture for prompts of at least 100,000 bytes); the call's native-binary hash and bundled catalog entry hash must equal the lane preflight's

settings_scope: Settings recorded for the original calls used by the corrected-input replay, grouped by identical configuration. Fresh correction and recovery calls preserve these inference settings; epoch identity belongs to provenance.
